name: Applied Industrial Technologies
outlook:
What Applied Industrial Technologies says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: earnings per shareToday, the Company is modestly increasing fiscal 2027 EPS guidance to a range of $11.70 to $12.20 (prior $11.65 to $12.15) to reflect a slightly lower diluted share count assumption following first quarter share repurchases.
  • Fiscal 2027: sales and EBITDA marginThe Company is maintaining guidance for sales of up 4.0% to 6.5%, as well as EBITDA margins of 12.5% to 12.8%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
